entries.definition: A software paradigm in which a qualified software whole may be lawfully reused as a part of a larger qualified whole.
entries.authority: research semantics; no production or promotion authority

entries.definition: Constrained semantic composition of the minimum needed capabilities until the requested consequence is lawful, followed by strong idiomatic embodiment in the host language.
entries.authority: method; earns no result without evidence

entries.definition: A downstream audit for adherence to applicable coding standards, style, correctness, hygiene, packaging, tests, and assurance boundaries.
entries.authority: audit-only unless a project separately grants a gate

entries.definition: The research operating surface used to pressure HSP hypotheses.
The Observe-Attack-Repair-Reattack adversarial slice used inside HSP research.
A non-authoritative lane for testing whether explicit semantic obligations can guide host-language embodiment.
The narrow evaluate(doc) Pareto-frontier experiment. It lost to a simple greedy adaptive path in the repaired seven-rival sealer domain.
entries.authority: advisory only; must never be labeled HSP alone

entries.definition: The mechanism phrase used when describing Practical Coding.
A distinct historical surface. No equivalence to HSP, PC, or CSC is established by this registry.
An adjacent iterative engineering loop; it is not an expansion of HSP or CSC.

errata.incorrect: HSP means or is interchangeable with the document-frontier evaluator.
errata.corrected: HSP means Holonic Software Paradigm. The document evaluator is HSP-DF and is a narrowed advisory branch.

errata.incorrect: CSC means constrained semantic composition or supplies HSP's semantic compiler.
errata.corrected: CSC means Code Slop Cleanup and is downstream final QA. Write out constrained semantic composition.

errata.incorrect: Practical Coding is a style doctrine or another name for CSC.
errata.corrected: Practical Coding is the composition-and-lowering method; CSC audits the resulting artifact afterward.

errata.incorrect: HSP, PC, or CSC automatically grants runtime, production, promotion, or world-mutation authority.
errata.corrected: Authority must be explicit, current, referent-bound, and consequence-side checked.

invariants: Every active abbreviation identifies at most one active referent.
CSC expands only to Code Slop Cleanup.
Constrained semantic composition has no CSC abbreviation.
HSP-DF is never shortened to HSP.
Genome remains separate unless later evidence explicitly earns a relation.
No method or audit label silently grants runtime, production, promotion, or world-mutation authority.
